title: Verbs and status codes
description: HTTP API fundamentals with standards-grounded Node.js examples, locally executable positive and negative contracts, and a complete real HTTP capstone.
objectives: Map HTTP method semantics to appropriate success and error codes; distinguish GET/HEAD, POST creation, PATCH edits, DELETE success and 405 with Allow.
Repair the http-method-status failing instructor contract.
Explain the production limitation of a local Node HTTP exercise.
rubric: I can apply the HTTP semantics for verbs and status codes.
I can reproduce and fix the 10.02.01 defect with real Node or fetch APIs.
I can explain the security or durability work needed before deployment.
